name: showreel-c3-looks-expensive

voice.text: One looks five times pricier. Which one would you pay more for? It's B. Turns out, three things make it look expensive. Empty space. Small, spaced-out letters. And only two colours. Quiet costs more.

caption:
One of these looks 5× pricier. Same product, same shelf. 🛍️

1. Empty space. Room around the name says nothing is fighting for attention.
2. Small, spaced-out letters. Capitals with a little extra spacing read calm and confident.
3. Only two colours. Fewer colours read as a choice, not a mix.

Save this for your next label, logo or price tag. Did you pick B too?
keywords: how to make design look expensive

sources.title: How to Create a Luxurious User Experience (CXL): white space, fewer products, fewer colours
